title: perception.frame wave 1 (protocol v2)
description: Server -> client, one per analysed frame (PROTOCOL_v2.md): detection + tracking + traffic-light state from the FAST lane, carrying the latest distances / lanes / road / signs of the slow lane (blockAges, distanceAgeMs), so a client that ignores wave 2 still works. All v1 fields (perception_frame.v1.schema.json) plus wave, echo and per-object distanceAgeMs. Produced by perception_engine/perception/realtime/wire.py to_wire().

seq.description: Per session: video = source frame counter (gaps = frames dropped to stay realtime); sim = submitted frame counter; live = uplinked frame counter (gaps = skipped frames).

sessionId.description: Changes on every new stream (new hello). Track ids are only comparable within one session.

frameIndex.description: video / sim: frame index in the clip (decode order); live: = seq.

ptsSeconds.description: video / sim: container pts of the analysed clip frame (what the tablet's player reports). live: (captureTimeNs - first captureTimeNs of the session) / 1e9, i.e. real time on the tablet's capture clock.

serverTimeMs.description: Unix epoch ms on the laptop when the message was built.

processingMs.description: Frame available on the server -> message built (includes queue wait, JPEG decode).

blockAges.description: Analysed frames since each block last produced the carried result (0 = this frame). Fast blocks (detection, tracking, lights) are always 0; slow blocks (distance, depth, lanes, road, signs) count fast frames since the frame they analysed.

bbox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] px in the `image` space (the upright image; see image).

echo.description: Copied from the SDC1 uplink header of the analysed frame (live mode); null for video / sim. The client measures capture -> result latency on its own clock: nowNs - captureTimeNs.

source.description: video / sim: kind 'video', id = clip stem (videoId); live: kind 'camera', id = clientId.

image.description: Coordinate space of every bbox / lane / road point: the upright analysed image (live: the uplinked JPEG after rotationDegrees, scaled down only if wider than the server's input.max_width, 1280; video / sim: the clip frame). Normalise by these to map onto the display.

camera.description: Pinhole camera of the session in `image` pixels: client.hello intrinsics (live) or defaults (BDD 700 px focal at 1280 wide); horizonY / cameraHeightMeters are the depth block's current estimates (a client-given mountHeightMeters is used as is).

signClass.description: camelCase, e.g. stop, yield, doNotEnter, speedLimit45, pedestrianCrossing

lanes.description: Plan section 10. Lanes numbered 1..laneCount from the left.

boundaryColors.description: Optional, parallel to laneBoundaries (same order and length; index i describes laneBoundaries[i]): paint colour of each line. In the US a yellow line is the left edge of the ego direction of travel. Absent when the lanes block has no per-line metadata.

boundaryStyles.description: Optional, parallel to laneBoundaries (same order and length; index i describes laneBoundaries[i]): solid or dashed paint. Absent when the lanes block has no per-line metadata.

road.description: Plan section 13: where AR content can be anchored.

groundXZ.description: [lateral m (+ right), forward m] on the flat ground, from the session camera.

drivablePolygon.description: Optional (v2): outline of the visible drivable road, closed polygon of [x, y] px (at most 32 points, simplified). It excludes the dashboard, hood and A-pillars, so the tablet keeps AR content inside it. Empty when unknown.

perceivedObject.description: One tracked object with everything known about it fused by track id (plan section 7 detection + 8 motion + 9 distance + 11 light state).

id.description: Track id, stable across frames of one session (plan section 8). Traffic lights / signs: >= staticIdOffset (1,000,000).

distanceMeters.description: Forward distance from the camera (m). Vehicles / pedestrians have one whenever any estimate is possible: the latest slow-lane distance (fused, depth_model, ground_plane, width_prior) while it is younger than slow.max_distance_age_s, else a geometry-only one from this frame (geometry).

distanceMethod.description: fused / depth_model / ground_plane / width_prior: slow lane (DA3 depth + geometry, per-track Kalman). geometry: fast lane, size prior + flat ground on this frame (confidence <= 0.5). size_prior: traffic lights / signs.

distanceAgeMs.description: Age of the carried distance: media ms between the frame it was measured on and this frame (0 = measured on this frame; null = no distance).

ttcSeconds.description: Time to collision from box scale change; null when not closing.

inEgoPath.description: Box bottom inside the ego VEHICLE's corridor: +-1.3 m on flat ground around the ego heading (the ego lane direction from the lanes block, else the camera axis), up to 80 m ahead. Falls back to the ego lane / static polygon when the camera height or horizon is unknown. null for traffic lights and signs.
